AuthConfig.description:
Reference to a stored credential plus flow hints for the scraper.

The actual username/password/token lives in the secrets service and is
fetched at scrape time using the caller's license token — it is NEVER
passed inline in a scrape request.

credential_id.description: ID of the credential stored in the secrets service
credential_id.title: Credential Id

login_url.description: Explicit login URL. If omitted, the scraper will attempt the login flow on whatever page the target URL redirects to.
login_url.title: Login Url

password_selector.description: CSS selector for the password input (optional, defaults to common patterns)
password_selector.title: Password Selector

submit_selector.description: CSS selector for the submit button (optional, defaults to common patterns)
submit_selector.title: Submit Selector

username_selector.description: CSS selector for the username/email input (optional, defaults to common patterns)
username_selector.title: Username Selector

wait_for_selector.description: CSS selector to wait for after submit (alternative to wait_for_url)
wait_for_selector.title: Wait For Selector

wait_for_url.description: URL regex/glob to wait for after submit (confirms login succeeded)
wait_for_url.title: Wait For Url

wait_timeout_ms.description: Max milliseconds to wait for post-login state
wait_timeout_ms.title: Wait Timeout Ms

AuthConfig.title: AuthConfig

AuthType.description:
Authentication flow selector for a scrape request.

Attributes:
    FORM: Fill a login form with username/password from the credential.
    STORAGE_STATE: Inject a previously captured Playwright storageState.
    BEARER: Set ``Authorization: Bearer <token>`` from the credential.
    BASIC: Set HTTP Basic auth on the browser context.
AuthType.title: AuthType

BulkScrapeRequest.description:
Request model for scraping multiple URLs.

Attributes:
    urls: List of URLs to scrape.
    scraper_type: Backend scraper to use for all URLs.
    javascript_enabled: Force Playwright in AUTO mode (ignored otherwise).
    timeout: Request timeout in seconds per URL.
    follow_links: Whether to follow links on scraped pages.
    max_depth: Maximum crawl depth when following links.
    allowed_domains: Domains allowed when following links.
    link_query: Optional topic used to score links and order the crawl frontier.
    sort_links_by_score: Whether to return links ranked by score.

allowed_domains.description: Restrict link following to these domains (subdomains included). Applied to every followed link; the seed URLs themselves are always scraped. Omit to follow any same-site link the page declares. Entries are bare hostnames — 'example.com', not a URL or a wildcard.
allowed_domains.title: Allowed Domains

auth_config.description: Optional authentication configuration referencing a stored credential. Login is performed once and the session is reused across all URLs.

delay.description: Post-load delay in seconds before content extraction
delay.title: Delay

download_images.description: Download image content and include base64-encoded bytes in response
download_images.title: Download Images

extraction_schema.description: Optional declarative CSS schema applied to every scraped page, producing extracted_data per result.

javascript_enabled.description: Force a JS-rendering backend (Playwright) when scraper_type is 'auto'. Ignored when scraper_type names an explicit backend.
javascript_enabled.title: Javascript Enabled

link_query.description: Optional topic (e.g. 'pricing plans') used to score discovered links. With follow_links it also orders the Scrapy crawl frontier best-first, so a depth-limited crawl spends its budget on relevant pages.
link_query.title: Link Query

sort_links_by_score.description: Return links[] ranked by score (descending) instead of document order
sort_links_by_score.title: Sort Links By Score

stealth.description: Apply browser-level stealth patches to each page. Requires a browser backend; not combinable with follow_links.
stealth.title: Stealth

virtual_scroll.description: Scroll each page (or a container) before extracting. Forces the Playwright backend; not combinable with follow_links, which crawls via Scrapy.

wait_for_selector.description: CSS selector to wait for before scraping (Playwright only)
wait_for_selector.title: Wait For Selector

wait_until.description: Page-load wait condition: 'load' (default), 'domcontentloaded', 'networkidle', or 'commit'. 'networkidle' is an explicit opt-in only — on live SPAs with analytics/websockets/polling the network never goes 500ms-quiet, so it blocks the whole timeout and returns empty content on a good page. An invalid value is rejected with 422 (rather than reaching page.goto and returning a FAILED result).
wait_until.title: Wait Until

BulkScrapeRequest.title: BulkScrapeRequest

BulkScrapeResponse.description:
Response model for bulk scrape operations.

Attributes:
    total_urls: Number of URLs in the request.
    completed: Number of successfully scraped URLs.
    failed: Number of URLs that failed to scrape.
    results: Individual scrape results for each URL.
    processing_time_seconds: Total time for all URLs.
BulkScrapeResponse.title: BulkScrapeResponse

details.description: Optional debug detail; only populated when LEAK_EXCEPTION_DETAILS=true
details.title: Details

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp the error was emitted
timestamp.title: Timestamp

ExtractionField.description:
One field in a declarative extraction schema.

Attributes:
    name: Output key for this field in each extracted record.
    selector: CSS selector, relative to the enclosing element. Omit to read
        the enclosing element itself.
    type: How to pull the value (see ExtractionFieldType).
    attribute: Attribute name to read when ``type`` is ``attribute``.
    transform: Optional string transform applied to scalar values.
    default: Value used when the selector matches nothing.
    fields: Child fields, required for nested/list/nested_list.

attribute.description: Attribute to read when type is 'attribute'
attribute.title: Attribute

default.description: Value used when the selector matches nothing
default.title: Default

selector.description: CSS selector relative to the enclosing element
selector.title: Selector

ExtractionField.title: ExtractionField

ExtractionFieldType.description:
How a schema field pulls its value out of the matched element.

``computed`` and ``regex`` from the upstream crawl4ai dialect are
deliberately absent — see services.extraction_schema for why.
ExtractionFieldType.title: ExtractionFieldType

ExtractionSchema.description:
Declarative CSS schema describing repeated records on a page.

Wire-compatible with crawl4ai's ``JsonCssExtractionStrategy`` dialect:
``baseSelector`` is accepted as an alias for ``base_selector``, so an
existing crawl4ai schema can be sent verbatim.

Attributes:
    name: Human label for the schema (echoed nowhere; aids debugging).
    base_selector: Selector matching one element per record.
    fields: Fields to extract from each matched record.

baseSelector.description: CSS selector matching one element per record
baseSelector.title: Baseselector

fields.description: Fields to extract from each matched record
fields.title: Fields

ExtractionSchema.title: ExtractionSchema

HealthResponse.description:
Health check response model for the /health endpoint.

Attributes:
    status: Service health status ('healthy' or 'unhealthy').
    timestamp: ISO8601 formatted timestamp of the check.
    service: Name of the service.
    version: Semantic version of the service.
    playwright_available: Whether Playwright library is installed.
    browser_ready: Whether browser instance is initialized.
HealthResponse.title: HealthResponse

ImageInfo.description:
Information about a discovered image.

Attributes:
    src: The image source URL.
    alt: The image alt text.
    title: The image title attribute.
    width: Natural width in pixels.
    height: Natural height in pixels.
    content_base64: Base64-encoded image bytes (when download_images=true).
    mime_type: Detected MIME type of downloaded image.
    byte_size: Size of downloaded image in bytes.
ImageInfo.title: ImageInfo

LinkInfo.description:
Information about a discovered hyperlink.

Attributes:
    text: The link's anchor text.
    url: The link's target URL.
    rel: The link's rel attribute value.
    type: Classification as 'internal' or 'external'.
    score: Relevance score in [0, 1] (see services.link_scoring). Present
        on every link; higher is more relevant. When the request carries a
        ``link_query`` the score blends intrinsic link quality with how well
        the anchor text and URL slug match that query. ``type == "internal"``
        remains the same-domain signal — it is not duplicated here.

score.description: Relevance score in [0, 1]; higher is more relevant
score.title: Score

LinkInfo.title: LinkInfo

ScrapeRequest.description:
Request model for scraping a single URL.

Attributes:
    url: The URL to scrape.
    scraper_type: Backend scraper to use.
    javascript_enabled: Force Playwright in AUTO mode (ignored otherwise).
    timeout: Request timeout in seconds.
    wait_for_selector: CSS selector to wait for before scraping.
    wait_until: Page load wait condition.
    screenshot: Whether to capture a screenshot.
    viewport_width: Browser viewport width in pixels.
    viewport_height: Browser viewport height in pixels.
    user_agent: Custom User-Agent header.
    headers: Custom HTTP headers.
    cookies: Custom cookies to send.
    link_query: Optional topic used to score discovered links.
    sort_links_by_score: Whether to return links ranked by score.

auth_config.description: Optional authentication configuration referencing a stored credential. When present, forces the Playwright scraper for form/storage_state types.

delay.description: Post-load delay in seconds before content extraction
delay.title: Delay

download_images.description: Download image content and include base64-encoded bytes in response
download_images.title: Download Images

extraction_schema.description: Optional declarative CSS schema for pulling repeated records (listings, tables, team pages) into extracted_data. Runs against the page HTML, so it works with every backend. Wire-compatible with crawl4ai's JsonCssExtractionStrategy dialect.

javascript_enabled.description: Force a JS-rendering backend (Playwright) when scraper_type is 'auto'. Ignored when scraper_type names an explicit backend.
javascript_enabled.title: Javascript Enabled

link_query.description: Optional topic (e.g. 'pricing plans') used to score discovered links. Every link always carries a score; supplying a query blends topical relevance into it. Does not filter or reorder unless sort_links_by_score is set.
link_query.title: Link Query

no_cache.description: Bypass the result cache for this request (always fetch fresh and do not store). The cache only ever holds anonymous COMPLETED scrapes.
no_cache.title: No Cache

scraper_type.description: Type of scraper to use (playwright for JS-heavy sites, scrapy for bulk)

sort_links_by_score.description: Return links[] ranked by score (descending) instead of document order. Off by default because document order is the existing contract.
sort_links_by_score.title: Sort Links By Score

stealth.description: Apply browser-level stealth patches (navigator.webdriver and friends) to the Playwright context. Applied automatically when AUTO escalates to Playwright after curl_cffi was already blocked; set explicitly to force it. Requires a browser backend: rejected with a 422 alongside an explicit non-browser scraper_type.
stealth.title: Stealth

virtual_scroll.description: Scroll the page (or a container) before extracting, so infinite feeds yield more than the first viewport. Forces the Playwright backend, since the other backends do not run JavaScript.

wait_for_selector.description: CSS selector to wait for before scraping (Playwright only)
wait_for_selector.title: Wait For Selector

wait_until.description: Page-load wait condition: 'load' (default), 'domcontentloaded', 'networkidle', or 'commit'. 'networkidle' is an explicit opt-in only — on live SPAs with analytics/websockets/polling the network never goes 500ms-quiet, so it blocks the whole timeout and returns empty content on a good page. An invalid value is rejected with 422 (rather than reaching page.goto and returning a FAILED result).
wait_until.title: Wait Until

ScrapeRequest.title: ScrapeRequest

ScrapeResponse.description:
Response model for a completed scrape operation.

Attributes:
    url: The original requested URL.
    final_url: The final URL after redirects.
    html_content: Raw HTML content of the page.
    text_content: Extracted visible text content.
    markdown_content: Extracted main content as Markdown (LLM/RAG-ready).
    title: Page title.
    metadata: Extracted metadata (Open Graph, meta tags, etc.).
    structured_data: Embedded structured data (JSON-LD, microdata, OpenGraph, microformats).
    links: List of discovered hyperlinks.
    images: List of discovered images.
    screenshot_base64: Base64-encoded screenshot PNG.
    status: Operation status.
    error: Error message if status is FAILED.
    scraper_used: Name of the scraper that processed the request.
    processing_time_seconds: Time taken to complete the scrape.

example.text_content:
Example Domain
This domain is for use in examples...
example.title: Example Domain

extracted_data.description: Records pulled by the request's extraction_schema, one dict per matched element. None when no schema was supplied; an empty list means a schema ran and matched nothing.
extracted_data.title: Extracted Data

scraper_used.description: Name of scraper that processed this
scraper_used.title: Scraper Used

storage_state.description: Playwright storageState captured after successful auth. Cache and reuse via auth_config.type='storage_state' to avoid re-logging-in.
storage_state.title: Storage State

structured_data.description: Embedded structured data (JSON-LD, microdata, OpenGraph, microformats)
structured_data.title: Structured Data

ScrapeResponse.title: ScrapeResponse

ScrapeStatus.description:
Status of a scrape operation.

Attributes:
    QUEUED: Operation is waiting to be processed.
    RUNNING: Operation is currently in progress.
    COMPLETED: Operation finished successfully.
    FAILED: Operation encountered an error.
ScrapeStatus.title: ScrapeStatus

ScraperType.description:
Available scraper backend types.

Attributes:
    PLAYWRIGHT: Use Playwright for JavaScript rendering.
    SCRAPY: Use Scrapy for efficient bulk crawling.
    HTTPX: Use httpx + BeautifulSoup for fast static page scraping.
    CURL_CFFI: Use curl_cffi (Chrome TLS/JA3 impersonation) for static pages
        behind network-layer anti-bot blocks; no JavaScript.
    AUTO: Automatically select the best scraper.
ScraperType.title: ScraperType

VirtualScrollConfig.description:
How to scroll a page to materialize lazily-loaded content.

Playwright-only: the other backends do not execute JavaScript, so supplying
this forces the Playwright backend in AUTO mode.

Attributes:
    container_selector: Element to scroll. Omit to scroll the window.
        Required to recover *virtualized* lists that recycle DOM nodes —
        without a container there is nothing to accumulate children from.
    scroll_count: Maximum scroll steps. Bounded because each step costs a
        real wait against the caller's timeout.
    scroll_by: Pixels per step; 0 means one viewport/container height.
    wait_ms: Pause after each step, for content to load.

container_selector.description: Element to scroll; omit to scroll the window
container_selector.title: Container Selector

scroll_by.description: Pixels to scroll per step; 0 means one viewport height
scroll_by.title: Scroll By

wait_ms.description: Pause after each step, in milliseconds
wait_ms.title: Wait Ms

VirtualScrollConfig.title: VirtualScrollConfig

BearerAuth.description: License token. Transport: `X-Tenant-Id: Bearer <token>` (not the Authorization header — that is reserved for caller-side auth).

info.description: Web scraping microservice with multiple backends: Playwright (JS-rendered pages), Scrapy (bulk crawling), and httpx+BeautifulSoup (fast static pages). Auto mode selects the best backend per URL. Auth: license token via `X-Tenant-Id: Bearer <token>`, validated against LICENSE_INTROSPECT_URL. Trusted-network clients (RFC 1918) bypass token requirement.
info.title: WebScraper Service

get.description: Provide service information at the root endpoint (public).

post.description:
Scrape multiple URLs in a single request.

Processes URLs sequentially to avoid overwhelming target servers.
Each URL is scraped independently and failures don't affect other URLs.

Args:
    request: Bulk scrape request containing list of URLs and options.
    token: JWT token payload for authentication.

Returns:
    BulkScrapeResponse with individual results for each URL and summary stats.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 500 error if bulk scraping fails catastrophically.
post.summary: Scrape multiple URLs in one request

post.description:
Scrape a single URL and extract content.

Uses Playwright for JavaScript-heavy sites or simple HTTP for static pages.
Supports screenshot capture, custom headers, cookies, and viewport settings.

Args:
    request: Scrape request containing URL and configuration options.
    token: JWT token payload for authentication.

Returns:
    ScrapeResponse containing extracted content, metadata, links, and images.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 500 error if scraping fails due to network or parsing errors.

get.description:
General health check endpoint with detailed service status.

Provides comprehensive health information including service version,
Playwright availability, and browser initialization status.

Kubernetes liveness probe endpoint.

Returns 200 if the service process is running and responding. Used by
Kubernetes to determine if the container should be restarted.

Kubernetes readiness probe endpoint.

Verifies that the service can handle incoming requests by checking
Playwright availability and browser initialization status. Returns 200 if
ready to serve traffic, 503 if not ready.
